8.name: Keep Calm and Drag On
8.overview: A hot new cast of queens enter the Werkroom as RuPaul kicks off the legendary race. Thandiwe Newton joins Michelle Visage and Alan Carr on the judging panel.

8.name: Goodies and Baddies
8.overview: It’s the iconic design challenge. Supermodels Erin O’Connor and Kristen McMenamy guest star.

8.name: Snatch Me If You Can
8.overview: Duncan James, Arian Nik, and Martin Fry join Ru on the panel as the queens fight it out to prove they have the best celebrity dating and improv skills on Snatch Me Out.

8.name: Croydon – The Rusical
8.overview: It’s Rusical week! The pressure is on as the queens’ singing, dancing, and acting skills are challenged as the queens pay homage to Chicago in the all-singing, all-dancing challenge: Croydon – The Rusical.

8.name: The Piggy Pageant
8.overview: This week the queens must go ham or go home as RuPaul stages the very first Piggy Pageant. Testing their stamina to the max the queens are challenged to serve three piggy themed looks on the runway - all against the clock! The pressure is on, but thankfully Drag Race favorite Just May - affectionately known as Season Four’s Pork Chop queen - is on hand to help. Pop legend Rick Astley and international fashion Icon Michèle Lamy join RuPaul, Michelle Visage and Graham Norton on the judging panel. Who will bring home the bacon this week?

8.name: Holiday Hits
8.overview: The queens take on a holiday novelty pop song for the girl group challenge. Anne-Marie and dance duo Booty Luv join RuPaul, Michelle Visage and Alan Carr.

8.name: Ghost Hunties
8.overview: The queens spoof a classic UK paranormal show in Ghost Hunties. Slow Horses star Kadiff Kirwan guest judges alongside Michelle Visage and Graham Norton.

8.name: Relative Beauties
8.overview: The queens are tasked with giving drag makeovers to some extra special subjects - their own family members. Cat Burns joins RuPaul on the judging panel.

8.name: The Last Laugh
8.overview: It's the semi-finals! In an awards show themed roast, the remaining queens fight for a place in the finale. Comedian Michelle De Swarte joins as guest judge.

8.name: Episode 10
8.overview: It’s the grand finale! Michelle Visage, Alan Carr, Graham Norton and the eliminated queens are all on hand as RuPaul crowns the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

overview: RuPaul has made the trip across the pond in search of a queen with the most charisma, uniqueness, nerve and talent in all the land.

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: RuPaul brings the award-winning global phenomenon to the UK for the first time. Ten of the country’s most fabulous drag queens will compete in the Olympics of drag in the hope that RuPaul, queen of queens, will crown them as the UK’s first Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.name: Series 2
seasons.overview: The award winning RuPaul’s Drag Race UK returns for a second series. Over the course of ten weeks twelve of the country’s most fabulous drag queens will compete to be crowned the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.name: Series 3
seasons.overview: The multi award winning RuPaul’s Drag Race UK is back for series 3! Over the course of ten weeks twelve fabulous drag queens will compete to be crowned The UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.name: Series 4
seasons.overview: RuPaul presides as twelve queens compete to be crowned the next Drag Race UK superstar.

seasons.name: Series 5
seasons.overview: A brand spanking new series of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK returns! Over the next ten weeks, a cast of fabulous new drag queens will compete for RuPaul’s seal of approval and the much coveted title of UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.name: Series 6
seasons.overview: Mama Ru is back with a hot new cast of rambunctious drag queens ready to do battle for the crown! Over the next ten weeks, the queens compete in a range of spicy challenges designed to test their drag mettle as they bid for the coveted title of the UK’s Next Drag Race Superstar.

seasons.name: Series 7
seasons.overview: Rest Easy. Mama's back! Start your engines, as a brand new set of fabulous queens enter the werkroom, hoping to win Mama Ru's seal of approval and take home the crown.

seasons.name: Series 8
seasons.overview: Hello, Hello, Hello! Mama's back with a brand new set of crown hungry queens! RuPaul is returning with a fresh batch of twelve sassy, snatched and seriously talented queens ready to race for glory. From jaw-dropping runway looks to unforgettable lip-sync battles, they'll stop at nothing to snatch the crown, a £25,000 cash prize, and the ultimate title of The UK's Next Drag Race Superstar.
